description: Append one worklog entry after a round of fixes so the next agent knows what changed and why. Every change requires at least one evidence reference (audit-run, finding, finding-state, page, proposal or doc); entries without evidence are rejected. Append-only: entries cannot be edited or deleted. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and changes nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result. Requires the sites:write scope.
name: record_worklog_entry
title: Record what this round changed
